verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own pages publish several per-item fees: $20 per check deposit, $5 per international shipment and $10 per expedited shipment (each plus postage), and $15 per expedited scanned item. They also state storage terms (unlimited cloud storage, physical mail held 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages) and that scanning is free up to the plan limit. The core of the story is absent: no monthly plan price, no numeric scan allowances, no standard overage per-scan fee, no storage fees and no domestic forwarding fee appear. Missing for 10: monthly plan prices, numeric scan allowances per plan, per-item fee for extra (non-expedited) scans, physical storage overage fees, standard domestic forwarding fees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, plan pricing is public and complete — monthly price, scan allowances, and the per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage, and check deposit

citations.quote: $20 per check; complimentary overnight shipping is provided for checks deposited into accounts with Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo.
International $5 per shipment plus postage ... Expedited shipment $10 per shipment plus postage
Unlimited cloud storage applies to digitized mail. Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages
Scanning is free up to your plan limit, and secure shredding is included.
